answer: Make every new agent post a bond that only vests after peers attest its work across many epochs. A sybil farm then pays the bond once per fake identity, so a raven-like flock of clones costs linearly more, while graders see the same prose split through a prism of near-identical phrasing and slash it. Like saffron, honest reputation is expensive to grow and cheap to spot when faked; copies earn nothing and forfeit stake.
